title: Application database role separation
objective: Detect an app login that can update user roles or role-change records.
threshold: All four zero-row UPDATE probes must be denied by database privilege checks.
risks: Application credential can escalate roles or alter access-change evidence

title: Database-triggered role-change audit
objective: Detect a direct privileged update to a user role that fails to create an audit row.
threshold: A rollback-only direct role update creates exactly one matching audit row.
risks: Privileged database update changes access without leaving proof

title: Quarterly access review completeness
objective: Detect an application account whose current role has no independent review in the open quarter.
threshold: Every account has a current-quarter review by someone else, matching the account's present role and latest role-change row.
risks: Quarterly access review is missed or incomplete

title: Authenticator enrollment
objective: Detect an application account that can still authenticate with a password alone.
threshold: Every account has a confirmed authenticator. A database with no accounts is no_sample.
risks: An account can sign in with only a password

title: High-risk logins use step-up
objective: Detect a session issued for a high-risk login that did not complete step-up.
threshold: A successful login at or above the step-up score recorded that step-up was completed. No login events is no_sample.
risks: Credential stuffing bypasses login limits

title: Approved trade intents have a human approver
objective: Detect an approved trade intent that has no approver.
threshold: Every approved intent records the approver. No intents is no_sample.
risks: An agent proposal is treated as an approved trade

title: Asset inventory completeness
objective: Detect a missing or incomplete inventory of the systems that hold credentials, orders, or control evidence.
threshold: The inventory lists the application, database, source repository, and evidence store, each with an owner, location, and data class.
risks: The asset inventory omits a system that holds credentials or evidence

title: AML cases stay inside their SLA
objective: Detect an AML case that is still open after its due time or was closed late.
threshold: Every AML case is closed by its due time. A book with no cases is no_sample.
risks: Repeated cash movements can hide structuring or rapid movement

title: Auditor evidence bundle hash
objective: Detect stored control evidence whose payload hash does not match the recorded digest.
threshold: Every latest evidence row matches its sha256. No evidence rows is no_sample.
risks: An auditor bundle does not match the stored evidence

title: Risk brief figures match the stored inputs
objective: Detect a stored brief that contains a number absent from its stored figures.
threshold: Every stored brief verifies against its figures. No briefs is no_sample.
risks: A narrative states a risk number that was not computed

title: Protected change and CI gate
objective: Verify main requires a pull request and six CI jobs, and the checked-out commit passed those jobs.
threshold: Pull request and all six required jobs enforced for admins; latest push run succeeds on the checked-out commit.
risks: Uncontrolled or untested change reaches the protected branch

title: Daily bars block bad symbols
objective: Detect an open data-quality finding for a symbol whose bars are missing, stale, non-positive, jumpy, or inconsistent across sources.
threshold: No open data-quality finding. No findings is no_sample.
risks: A risk number is computed from a bar that failed a data-quality check

title: Append-only control evidence
objective: Detect an application login that can change or delete stored control evidence.
threshold: Both a zero-row update and a zero-row delete of control_evidence are denied.
risks: Local control evidence is changed or deleted

title: Forecast signal stays off when the monitor trips
objective: Detect an open finding that the advisory forecast monitor is disabled.
threshold: The advisory signal is absent while the monitor is disabled. No monitor finding is no_sample.
risks: A degraded forecast still changes a risk decision

title: Customer notice stays inside 30 days
objective: Detect an incident whose customer notice is missing or late against the 30-day clock.
threshold: Customer notice is recorded on or before the due time. No incidents is no_sample.
risks: Customer notice exceeds 30 days after discovery

title: Paper-account ledger integrity and reconciliation
objective: Detect changed ledger postings, unbalanced events, and cash or positions that differ from the ledger.
risks: Undetected alteration of paper-account balances or positions

title: Watchlist quote source-date freshness
objective: Detect missing or stale provider quotes for active hot-tier symbols.
threshold: Quote source date older than seven calendar days, or missing.
risks: Stale reference prices presented as current market data

title: Audited trading halt
objective: Stop new paper trades and orders when an administrator activates the halt, while keeping a transition history.
threshold: Every state change has an ordered event with a named administrator and reason; new entries stop while halted.
risks: Paper trading continues during an operational halt

title: Paper-order reference price band
objective: Reject stock orders priced more than 20% from a usable reference quote and detect open orders that later breach the band.
threshold: Price outside 80-120% of a reference quote no older than seven calendar days, or an unusable quote.
risks: Erroneous paper orders executed at extreme prices

title: Stock concentration limit
objective: Reject a stock buy when holdings and open buy orders would exceed 50% of account equity in one symbol.
evidence: GitHub Actions backend job for the reviewed commit; operating sample pending
threshold: Projected single-stock exposure must not exceed 50% of account equity.
risks: Paper order breaches concentration limit

title: Trade-entry retry deduplication
objective: Prevent repeated order or direct-trade requests with the same user key from creating a second execution.
threshold: User/key uniqueness enforced and every committed request has a saved response.
risks: Duplicate paper trades after a network retry

title: Stock position-size limit
objective: Reject a stock buy when holdings and open buy orders would exceed the configured dollar cap for one symbol.
evidence: GitHub Actions backend job for the reviewed commit; operating sample pending
threshold: Projected single-stock exposure must not exceed $50,000 by default.
risks: Paper stock position exceeds its dollar cap

title: Buying-power reservation invariant
objective: Detect an account whose open buy orders reserve more cash than the account holds.
threshold: Reserved cash for open buy orders does not exceed the account cash balance.
risks: Paper order spends more than available buying power

title: SAR drafts cite only the case events
objective: Detect a stored narrative that cites an event outside the case or that states a filing decision.
threshold: Every stored draft cites exactly the case event ids and contains no filing decision. No drafts is no_sample.
risks: A narrative cites events the case does not contain or decides to file

title: Injection text cannot remain a proposal
objective: Detect a proposed intent whose rationale or source text matched the injection scan.
threshold: Injection text is stored only as a rejected intent. No intents is no_sample.
risks: Untrusted text reaches an agent and changes a proposal

title: Secret scanning on repository changes
objective: Verify the Gitleaks CI job passed on the checked-out commit.
threshold: Gitleaks secrets job succeeds on the latest push run for the checked-out commit.
risks: Secret committed without detection

title: Sanctions screening on named accounts and withdrawals
objective: Detect a named account or a paper withdrawal that lacks a clear sanctions screen.
threshold: Every named account has a clear onboarding screen and every withdrawal has a clear payout screen. No names and no withdrawals is no_sample.
risks: A sanctioned name receives a paper withdrawal

title: Surveillance cases stay inside their SLA
objective: Detect a surveillance case that is still open after its due time or was closed late.
threshold: Every surveillance case is closed by its due time. A book with no cases is no_sample.
risks: Manipulation alerts are not reviewed before the case SLA
